source_provenance.original_visual_authority: V5 generative exploration board selected 茶作 D / 连笔一体
source_provenance.previous_vectorization_method: faithful local raster-to-vector contour extraction with light denoise; no re-ideation
source_provenance.reason_for_reuse: Avoid repeating completed raster-to-vector extraction and avoid derivative-of-derivative drift. TYP-M02 formalizes the already verified faithful geometry as a bounded black/white method test; it does not claim the later leaf/surface route passed.

execution.route: Clone the previously faithful editable vector geometry into a new isolated sandbox frame, strip all non-structural effects/strokes, normalize the glyph to a single ivory structural fill on black, and do not redraw or reinterpret the lettering.
execution.readback_observation: One connected 茶作 D wordmark skeleton is visible in ivory on black with no leaves, texture, gradient, shadow, or surface rescue.

questions: Does the result read immediately as 茶作 rather than an ambiguous shape?
Does the black/ivory skeleton preserve enough of the authored 茶作 D design character to be worth continuing?

rule_admission.reason: No typography method may enter VPD production rules before controlled actual-pixel human acceptance and explicit user approval.
